entries.decision: Use nosemgrep inline comments instead of blanket crate exclusion for FFI unsafe blocks
entries.rationale: Each unsafe block already has a SAFETY comment explaining invariants. nosemgrep forces deliberate consideration for any new unsafe — blanket exclusion would silently accept unjustified unsafe blocks. Pragmatic: prevents tech debt while keeping the safety gate active.
alternatives: Exclude markymark-kernels/ from unsafe rules entirely (easy but loses gate)
Dismiss findings on GitHub (quick but no future protection)
entries.impact: 21 nosemgrep comments across 6 files in markymark-kernels/src/

entries.decision: Use Bash heredoc instead of Write tool for files containing ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
entries.rationale: Harness PreToolUse hook blocks Write tool when content contains ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, interpreting it as self-modification

entries.decision: Filed separate bug for pre-existing test_select_binary.sh failures rather than fixing inline
entries.rationale: Out of scope for marky-1vb task. Test failures are structural (JSON path mismatch), not related to hook integration
alternatives: Fix tests inline during hook work

entries.decision: Accept partial dry-run validation (only core passes) and defer full sequential publish validation to marky-hoh
entries.rationale: cargo publish --dry-run cannot resolve deps that aren't on crates.io yet. Core passing validates metadata format is correct. The actual sequential publish during release will validate the rest.
alternatives: Attempt to publish core first to unblock dry-run for others
entries.impact: marky-hoh release task must do sequential publish validation

entries.decision: Dual-transport architecture: LSP and MCP as pluggable layers over shared core
entries.rationale: Enables both editor (LSP) and AI assistant (MCP) use cases from single codebase without duplication
entries.impact: 6-crate workspace: core, parser, index, lsp, mcp, cli

entries.decision: CoreEngine trait lives in markymark-core, not a transport crate
entries.rationale: Transport abstraction (CoreOperation, CoreResult, CoreEngine) has no protocol-specific deps. Each transport crate converts protocol types internally.
entries.impact: 6 crates instead of 7. No cross-protocol dependencies.

entries.decision: tower-lsp-server v0.23 (community fork) over stale tower-lsp v0.20
entries.rationale: Original hasn't been updated since Aug 2023. Fork is actively maintained (Biome, Oxc, Veryl use it), supports edition 2024.
entries.impact: Import paths use tower_lsp_server::, ls_types not lsp_types

entries.decision: rmcp (official Rust MCP SDK) over async-mcp
entries.rationale: rmcp is official from modelcontextprotocol org (v0.13.0), has #[tool] macros, multi-transport support. async-mcp was small community crate.
entries.impact: Workspace schemars pinned to 1.2 for rmcp compatibility

entries.decision: FULL text document sync mode (not INCREMENTAL) for v1 LSP server
entries.rationale: FULL sync is simpler — each change replaces entire document text. INCREMENTAL requires precise byte-offset/UTF-16 arithmetic. Can upgrade later if performance requires it.
entries.impact: did_change handler takes last content change. ServerState replaces entire text, re-parses, re-indexes.

entries.decision: Separate markymark-lsp into convert/state/server modules
entries.rationale: Testing LanguageServer trait methods requires LSP service running. Separating state and conversions lets tests exercise core logic directly without transport.
entries.impact: Tests exercise convert and state directly. Server module is thin adapter.

entries.decision: Use slugify(heading.text) for duplicate slug detection, not heading.slug
entries.rationale: DocumentIndex pre-deduplicates slugs (details, details-1, details-2), so heading.slug is always unique by construction. Must compute base slug from raw text to detect duplicate heading text.

entries.decision: Drop read lock before async client.publish_diagnostics() call
entries.rationale: Holding RwLock read guard across await point causes deadlocks if didChange tries to acquire write lock concurrently. Scope the read lock, collect diagnostics into local Vec, then call async method after lock dropped.
entries.impact: Pattern used for all publish_diagnostics calls in didOpen, didChange, didClose.

entries.decision: CoreEngine trait in markymark-core, MCP routes through forwarding facade
entries.rationale: Shared operation trait codified in core de-risks transport divergence. Each transport is a thin adapter.
alternatives: Duplicate operation handling in mcp crate

entries.decision: RuntimeEngine validates roots and indexes markdown at startup, skips unreadable files
entries.rationale: Startup-time indexing makes tools behavior-complete. Failure isolation ensures one bad doc can't crash the MCP service.
alternatives: Move indexing into each tool call

entries.decision: Rewrite extract_xml_tags as single-pass stack tokenizer instead of multi-regex
entries.rationale: Copilot review found 4 bugs in two-pass regex: quadratic perf, self-closing nesting bug, > in attribute values, unnecessary allocation. Stack tokenizer fixes all simultaneously.
entries.impact: extract_xml_tags() is O(n) single-pass. Still uses regex only for attribute parsing within a tag.

entries.decision: CI pre-packages per-platform plugin archives instead of committing binaries to git or downloading at runtime
entries.rationale: Binaries in git bloats repo. Runtime download requires internet and error handling. CI pre-packaging gives each platform a self-contained archive with zero friction.
entries.impact: marky-8pt task, release CI workflow, select-binary.sh

entries.decision: Unified v1.0 epic with roadmap research as a separate child epic, not blocking shipping work
entries.rationale: Research (Track A/B/C) can proceed in parallel with shipping (CI, marketplace, docs). Making research block shipping would delay the product launch unnecessarily.
alternatives: Research as tasks in main epic (sequential)
entries.impact: marky-7pw child epic with 3 research tasks, all blocked only by marky-peu

entries.decision: Port high-value memories from markdown-mcp, filter out TypeScript/Marksman/maestro entries, update paths
entries.rationale: Old repo has 8+ days of accumulated knowledge (40+ successes, 6 failures, 43 decisions). Markymark repo had almost none after extraction. Filtering keeps signal high.
entries.impact: All harness memory files enriched: 5 rules, 3 failures, 15 decisions, 14+ patterns, architecture map

entries.decision: Hybrid arena ownership: per-document Bump for parsed content, realm-level owned storage for cross-doc index data
entries.rationale: Per-document arenas allow O(1) cleanup on re-parse (drop old arena, create new). Per-realm would require full reparse on any edit or accept monotonic growth. Realm-level index keeps owned copies of key lookup strings (slugs, tag names) for cross-doc queries.
alternatives: Per-realm (O(1) realm destroy but monotonic growth on edits)
entries.impact: All parser types get 'arena lifetime. DocumentIndex borrows from doc arena. RealmIndex keeps owned copies for cross-doc lookups.

entries.decision: Full migration depth: parser types (19 types) AND index types (8 types) in one epic
entries.rationale: Index types currently copy strings from parser output. With arena, index can borrow directly from parser arena, eliminating ~28 additional String allocations per document. Doing parser-only would leave the copy overhead.

entries.decision: Use hashbrown with bumpalo as custom allocator for HashMap fields
entries.rationale: bumpalo doesn't provide HashMap. hashbrown supports custom allocators via Allocator trait. This arena-allocates Frontmatter, Properties, and XmlTag attributes data alongside all other parsed content.
alternatives: Replace with sorted BumpVec (O(log n) lookup)
entries.impact: New dep: hashbrown. Affects Frontmatter, Properties, XmlTag, ListItem types.

entries.decision: Arena migration is post-alpha (does not block marky-peu/marky-hoh release)
entries.rationale: Alpha release uses owned types. Arena is a performance optimization for v0.2.0. Publishing owned-type API first is acceptable since pre-1.0 allows breaking changes. Avoids blocking the release pipeline.
alternatives: Parallel feature branch (merge conflict risk across 3 crates)
entries.impact: Arena epic depends on marky-peu completion

entries.decision: Use =0.1.0-alpha.1 (exact match) for cross-crate prerelease dependency specs
entries.rationale: Cargo requires explicit prerelease version matching. Without the = prefix, 0.1.0-alpha.1 is not matched by the semver range '0.1.0'. Each subcrate's path dependency must use =0.1.0-alpha.1.
alternatives: Use workspace.dependencies for internal crates (not supported for path deps with version)
Skip version field in path deps (breaks cargo publish)
entries.impact: All 5 subcrate Cargo.toml files. Pattern needed for every future prerelease.

entries.decision: Use branch + PR workflow for release commits instead of direct push to main
entries.rationale: PreToolUse hook blocks direct push to main/master. Created release/v0.1.0-alpha.1 branch, PR'd, merged, then tagged main separately.
entries.impact: All future releases must follow branch+PR+merge+tag flow

entries.decision: Download-on-first-run fallback for marketplace installs instead of requiring pre-bundled binary
entries.rationale: Marketplace install is git-clone based (no binary included). Auto-downloading from GitHub Releases /latest/download/ on first run bridges the gap with zero user friction. Falls back to manual instructions if download fails.

entries.decision: Use git-cliff with conventional commits for automated changelog generation in release workflow
entries.rationale: Project already uses conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, chore:). git-cliff is the standard Rust ecosystem tool (git-chglog deprecated Jan 2026). Integrates via orhun/git-cliff-action@v4 in release CI.
entries.impact: cliff.toml config added, release.yml updated with fetch-depth:0 + changelog step

entries.decision: marketplace.json at repo root .claude-plugin/ for self-hosted marketplace distribution
entries.rationale: Repo itself serves as both plugin source and marketplace. Users add via /plugin marketplace add sethyanow/markymark (remote) or local path. Plugin source is ./markymark-plugin relative to repo root.
entries.impact: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json created at repo root, 3 validation tests added

entries.decision: Single security.yml workflow with 4 parallel jobs (cargo-audit, cargo-deny, CodeQL, Semgrep) instead of integrated or per-tool workflows
entries.rationale: Clean separation from build/test (ci.yml), single management point, parallel jobs keep runtime fast. Integrating into ci.yml would grow it to 7 jobs. Per-tool workflows scatter management across 3 files.

entries.decision: Advisory-only security gates (not blocking PRs)
entries.rationale: User chose advisory-only for initial adoption. Findings reported as annotations but don't prevent merge. Can tighten to hard gates later after baseline is clean.
entries.impact: All 4 CI security jobs use continue-on-error: true

entries.decision: lefthook (Go binary) for pre-commit hooks instead of Python pre-commit or custom git hooks
entries.rationale: No Python runtime dependency. Single binary, fast, growing adoption. User explicitly chose this over Python pre-commit framework.
alternatives: Custom git hooks (no deps but less portable)
entries.impact: lefthook.yml at project root, requires lefthook binary

entries.decision: Use cargo-deny v0.19 config schema (drop deprecated vulnerability/unmaintained lint keys)
entries.rationale: Initial config based on older examples failed validation; updating to current schema is required for reliable CI checks.
alternatives: Use template defaults without explicit policy

entries.decision: Record baseline findings in bd notes before workflow rollout
entries.rationale: Captures initial signal/noise profile so later CI findings can be diffed against known baseline.
alternatives: Skip local baseline and rely only on CI
Store ephemeral scan artifacts in repo

entries.decision: Treat CodeQL as CI-only until local CLI is installed
entries.rationale: No local codeql binary is present; CI action provides supported path without blocking security workflow implementation.

entries.decision: Adopt lefthook pre-commit security chain with deterministic order and explicit tool-presence checks
entries.rationale: Keeps local guardrails strict and reproducible without Python runtime dependencies while providing clear failures when tooling is missing
entries.impact: lefthook.yml, README.md, and follow-up task marky-7za for custom Semgrep rules

entries.decision: Proceed with phased arena migration and defer checkpoint completion until parser regressions are fixed
entries.rationale: Phase 1/2/4 and GREEN test conversions landed successfully, but full verification gate still fails on two parser regressions. Accepting checkpoint as complete would hide known failures.
alternatives: Checkpoint as complete despite failing tests
Split regressions into separate fix feature
entries.impact: feature-001 remains in_progress; parser tests frontmatter/nested-list regressions must be resolved before ACCEPT

entries.decision: PropertyValue::as_str() returns Option<&str> instead of &str, with None for List variant
entries.rationale: Returning empty string for List masked bugs; callers should explicitly handle the non-string case
alternatives: Panic on List (strict but may break callers)

entries.decision: Reopen feature-001 in harness active state and remove premature archive entry
entries.rationale: Beads epics/tasks show g9t remediation still in progress; keeping feature archived would hide unresolved acceptance criteria and break state alignment.
alternatives: Keep feature archived despite open remediation work
Track remediation only in beads and ignore harness drift

entries.decision: Use child remediation epic marky-luy to execute unresolved g9t conformance criteria
entries.rationale: A focused remediation epic reduces scope creep while preserving marky-g9t as parent state anchor and existing decision history.
alternatives: Create a brand-new unrelated feature epic
entries.impact: beads issues marky-luy, marky-g9t, and g9t.* child tasks

entries.decision: Post full CodeRabbit review output (including codegen prompts) to marky-bjj for agent handoff
entries.rationale: Keeping review findings centralized in beads comments gives the next implementer complete context without re-running review.
alternatives: Keep review in local temp file only

entries.decision: Use bumpalo allocator-api2 feature (stable) not allocator_api (nightly) for hashbrown HashMap::new_in
entries.rationale: allocator_api requires nightly Rust; allocator-api2 implements allocator_api2::Allocator on stable, enabling ArenaHashMap with arena-allocated buckets per dec-arena-003.
alternatives: Fall back to HashMap with default allocator (keys/values only in arena)

entries.decision: Remove dead extract::extract_list_items; Ast uses collect_top_level_list_items with arena for list extraction
entries.rationale: extract_list_items was unused (Ast never called it). collect_top_level_list_items already takes arena and uses ListItem::list_items_from_list_node. Removing dead code ensures extraction API is consistently arena-driven.

entries.decision: DocumentIndex::from_ast takes Ast by value, uses arena_ptr + ptr::read + mem::forget to transfer arena ownership
entries.rationale: Borrow checker blocks into_arena() while arena ref is in use. Raw pointer breaks the borrow chain; ptr::read extracts arena, mem::forget avoids double-free of ast. All index data points into the arena we take ownership of.
alternatives: Change parser to parse_into(&Bump) - bigger API change
Two-phase: extract to owned Vec then build - defeats borrowing goal

entries.decision: RealmIndex cross-doc lookups use owned ResolvedHeading/ResolvedBlock and tag_to_docs HashMap
entries.rationale: Per dec-arena-001, realm-level owned storage for cross-doc lookups. Arena-backed refs from removed docs would dangle. Owned copies survive doc removal.
alternatives: Keep iterating docs and returning refs - breaks on doc remove
Separate realm arena for cross-doc - adds complexity

entries.decision: extract_list_items returns Vec<&ListItem> instead of Vec<ListItem> to avoid ArenaHashMap::clone
entries.rationale: Cloning ListItem clones its ArenaHashMap. hashbrown HashMap with bumpalo allocator triggers SIGSEGV on clone. Returning references to arena-allocated items avoids clone entirely.
alternatives: Use Vec<(key,value)> instead of HashMap for properties

entries.decision: Use arena-allocated empty slice for ListItem children_list instead of &[]
entries.rationale: Literal &[] creates reference to stack-local temporary; returning it causes use-after-free when ListItem outlives the function. bumpalo::collections::Vec::new_in(arena).into_bump_slice() gives valid &'arena [ListItem].
alternatives: Allocate empty array in arena upfront

entries.decision: Custom CountingAllocator in benchmark binary for heap allocation metrics
entries.rationale: Task required allocation count via global allocator counter. Wrapping System allocator with atomic counter gives per-iteration alloc count. Note: bumpalo uses its own allocation so count includes arena chunk growth.

entries.decision: Extend BlockId with source Range; compute from regex full match in extract_block_ids
entries.rationale: BlockEntry used hardcoded Range(0,0,0,0), causing go-to-definition for ^block-id to always jump to file start. Regex-extracted types should carry source position for LSP navigation.
alternatives: Compute range only in index layer
entries.impact: markymark-parser types/blocks.rs BlockId, extract.rs extract_block_ids, markymark-index document.rs BlockEntry

entries.decision: Keep baseline worktree at /tmp/markymark-baseline for benchmarking; only kill PIDs when user explicitly asks for process cleanup
entries.rationale: User corrected: they wanted PID cleanup only, not worktree removal. Baseline worktree enables quick pre/post arena comparison.

entries.decision: MARKYMARK_BENCH_HEAVY=1 for 100-sample runs; default to 10–20 samples to avoid RAM exhaustion on index_docs_dir (918 files)
entries.rationale: 100-sample index_docs_dir froze laptop. Real corpus bench allocates ~5.9MB × 100 iterations; default sample sizes are sufficient for most runs.
alternatives: Cap index_docs_dir at 20 samples in heavy mode
Run heavy bench on CI only

entries.decision: Add explicit benchmark tier controls for both sample count and corpus scale
entries.rationale: A single heavy flag did not provide enough control for iterative profiling versus scale validation. Tiered controls support fast dev loops (light) and progressively larger runs (medium/heavy/extreme) without editing code.
alternatives: Hardcode fixed sample/doc counts in benches

entries.decision: Automate benchmark ROI reporting with a dedicated runner binary that executes tiered benches and writes markdown
entries.rationale: Manual benchmark collection was slow and error-prone. Automating run + parse + report reduces operator overhead and creates a repeatable artifact for go/no-go arena ROI decisions.

entries.decision: Preserve duplicate block IDs in RealmIndex and keep first-in lookup semantics
entries.rationale: Overwriting duplicate block IDs silently dropped cross-document references. Storing all occurrences prevents data loss while returning the first entry preserves existing Option-based resolution behavior.
alternatives: Change lookup API to return Vec and propagate broad signature changes

entries.decision: Upgrade workspace allocator dependencies to bumpalo 3.19.1 and hashbrown 0.16.1
entries.rationale: Code review flagged outdated versions and security concerns on earlier hashbrown line. Upgrading keeps arena allocation strategy current and secure without changing allocator-api2 approach.
alternatives: Defer dependency upgrades to separate maintenance task
entries.impact: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, allocator-backed map usage in parser/index/core crates

entries.decision: Keep local epstein benchmark corpus file out of checkpoint commits unless explicitly requested
entries.rationale: The fixture is user-local context and should not be accidentally bundled with PR code cleanup commits.
entries.impact: checkpoint commit workflow and staging discipline for this branch

entries.decision: ArenaHashMap (!Send) restricted to parser types only; index types use std HashMap
entries.rationale: Bump:!Sync -> &Bump:!Send -> ArenaHashMap:!Send. tower-lsp requires Send+static for async handlers. Index types flow into ServerState via RealmIndex.
alternatives: Accept ArenaHashMap everywhere and restructure LSP to not require Send
entries.impact: markymark-index/src/document.rs (XmlTagEntry, DocumentIndex internal HashMaps), bumpalo.md docs

entries.decision: Adopt DocumentArena wrapper in Ast and DocumentIndex instead of raw Bump
entries.rationale: DocumentArena provides Debug, capacity hints, and clear semantic boundary. Option (a) from audit: use the wrapper everywhere vs (b) delete it.
alternatives: Delete DocumentArena and use raw Bump (option b)

entries.decision: Changed arena_ptr() to doc_arena_ptr() returning *const DocumentArena
entries.rationale: The ptr::read+forget pattern needs to read the whole DocumentArena (not just inner Bump) to transfer ownership cleanly between Ast and DocumentIndex.
alternatives: Keep *const Bump and cast to DocumentArena

entries.decision: Use LazyLock<Regex> static compilation for all 14 regex patterns in extract.rs
entries.rationale: CodeRabbit flagged regex recompilation on every function call as Major issue. LazyLock compiles each regex exactly once (first access) and reuses across all calls. No crate dependency added — LazyLock is in std since Rust 1.80.

entries.decision: MarkdownLinkEntry.url stores base URL only (without fragment); anchor stored separately
entries.rationale: CodeRabbit flagged that url field duplicated anchor info. Parser already splits URL at '#' — index was re-concatenating them. Storing base URL matches parser semantics and simplifies callers (no need to strip anchor from url).
alternatives: Keep concatenated url (matches browser URL bar behavior)
Remove anchor field entirely and only store full url

entries.decision: Accept 'static lifetime pattern with documentation; defer self_cell migration to marky-5yt
entries.rationale: Copilot flagged 'static as unsound. While inner &'static str can technically escape &self, all callers access through &self. Documenting the invariant + filing marky-5yt for proper fix is pragmatic given scope of arena migration.
entries.impact: markymark-parser/src/ast.rs, markymark-index/src/document.rs safety docs; marky-5yt issue

entries.decision: Use markymark realm indexing of 633-doc source vault for systematic gap analysis instead of manual file-by-file review
entries.rationale: Realm-based search-symbols queries cover all indexed headings efficiently. Combined with grep for inline content checks, this identified 7 gaps across 15+ topic areas in one pass.
alternatives: Manual file-by-file reading of source vault (too many files)
Rely on agent knowledge of what's missing (subjective)
entries.impact: 8 docs modified: ownership.md, idioms.md, anti-patterns.md, types.md, syntax-ref.md, MISTAKES.md, AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md

entries.decision: Add nomicon dot-operator derived-Clone autoref gotcha to anti-patterns rather than a standalone doc
entries.rationale: The gotcha is an anti-pattern that agents produce silently. It belongs where agents check for mistakes, not in a separate advanced concepts file.

entries.decision: Reorder Ast struct fields so root_elements is declared before arena to fix drop order
entries.rationale: Rust drops struct fields in declaration order. Arena was declared before root_elements, meaning Bump freed all memory before Element drop impls ran. Any Element containing ArenaHashMap would access a dangling &Bump reference on drop — undefined behavior.
alternatives: Use ManuallyDrop for arena (more complex, less idiomatic)
Implement custom Drop for Ast (overrides field drop order but adds maintenance burden)

entries.decision: Gate Ast Default impl behind #[cfg(test)] rather than removing or renaming to Ast::empty()
entries.rationale: Default impl panics via .expect() which is inappropriate for library code. Zero usages found in codebase. Gating behind #[cfg(test)] preserves it for future test convenience while removing the public API hazard.
alternatives: Rename to Ast::empty() (still panics, just with different name)

entries.decision: Merge origin/main into feature branch (not rebase) to resolve PR #10 squash merge conflicts
entries.rationale: PR #10 was squash-merged to main, causing 22 conflicts with the 52-commit feature branch. Rebase failed before (fail-feature-001-rebase-20260214). Merge commit is safest — preserves all history and clearly documents integration point.
alternatives: Reset main to before squash merge (force push to main, risky)

entries.decision: Copy and diverge Zig kernels from forge BRZA into markymark
entries.rationale: Simplest to start, avoids coordination overhead between forge and markymark repos. Can sync later if patterns converge. Shared kernels (embeddings, similarity, entity hashing) forked; markymark-specific kernels (heading/link/tag/block scan) are new.
alternatives: Zig package (clean versioning but coordination overhead)
Git submodule (explicit version control but submodule friction)
entries.impact: zig/src/shared/ directory contains forked forge kernels

entries.decision: Complement tree-sitter with Zig SIMD scanning, promotion path based on benchmarks
entries.rationale: Zig scans fast but context-unaware (false positives in code blocks). Tree-sitter precise but slower. Two-tier model: Tier 1 Zig for speed-critical ops, Tier 2 tree-sitter for precision. If Zig covers 95%+ accurately, promote to primary.
alternatives: Replace tree-sitter entirely (too risky, loses context awareness)
Complement only (no promotion path, keeps two systems permanently)

entries.decision: markymark-kernels crate below markymark-core in dependency graph
entries.rationale: Core defines traits (ScanBackend, EmbeddingProvider), kernels implements via Zig FFI. Other crates depend only on core. Feature-gated: zig-kernels flag in core enables kernels dep.
alternatives: Sibling to core (more wiring, less encapsulation)
Inside core as feature-gated module (simpler graph but larger core crate)
entries.impact: Dependency chain: kernels <- core <- index <- mcp

entries.decision: Hybrid SIMD-scalar heading scanner: SIMD finds newlines, scalar validates headings
entries.rationale: Headings are sparse in markdown. SIMD accelerates the common case (scanning prose for newlines) while scalar handles the rare case (parsing heading syntax). This avoids complex SIMD logic for # counting and space verification.
alternatives: Full SIMD heading parsing (complex, marginal benefit for sparse headings)
Pure scalar (simpler but slower on large documents)

entries.decision: Shared try_parse_heading between SIMD and scalar implementations
entries.rationale: Both SIMD and scalar paths need identical heading validation logic. Sharing the function ensures parity and reduces duplication. Made pub in reference module for SIMD module to import.
alternatives: Duplicate validation logic in each module

entries.decision: Embedding source agnostic via EmbeddingProvider trait
entries.rationale: Design the embedding index to be source-agnostic. Provider decision (local ONNX, API, TF-IDF) deferred to implementation time. Trait: embed, embed_batch, dimensions.
alternatives: Local ONNX only (self-contained but limits quality options)
API only (highest quality but network dependency)
TF-IDF in Zig (zero deps but lower semantic quality)

entries.decision: P2 parallel exploration priority, full upfront planning with user orchestration
entries.rationale: BRZA-markymark doesn't block v1.0 launch. Work on it alongside arena conformance and v1.0 tasks. All 17 tasks planned upfront with dependency graph for user-orchestrated execution.
alternatives: P1 with semantic search as launch feature (risky scope addition)
entries.impact: Epic marky-8s3 with 17 tasks across 7 phases

entries.decision: build.rs invokes zig build lib via std::process::Command with no external build dependencies
entries.rationale: Keeps the crate dependency-free. build.rs uses only std for Command, PathBuf, and env. Version parsing is manual (split on '-' then '.') to handle dev suffixes without regex crate.
alternatives: Use cc crate (overkill for invoking zig CLI)
Use which crate for zig lookup (unnecessary, PATH lookup via Command is sufficient)

entries.decision: rerun-if-changed set on zig/src/ directory and zig/build.zig, not individual .zig files
entries.rationale: Directory-level rerun-if-changed triggers on any file add/remove/modify within the directory. Avoids maintaining a list of individual zig source files as new kernels are added.

entries.decision: Add Zig to existing build-and-test CI job rather than separate zig-kernels job
entries.rationale: Minimum viable fix: markymark-kernels build.rs requires zig binary and was failing CI. Adding to existing job unblocks PR. Full marky-ayb task (separate job, platform matrix, feature gate) deferred.
alternatives: Separate zig-kernels CI job (full marky-ayb scope)
Feature-gate markymark-kernels to skip without Zig

entries.decision: Split C ABI exports into separate exports_*.zig files instead of adding to c_adapter.zig
entries.rationale: c_adapter.zig was at 793 lines. Adding 6 embedding exports + 18 tests would push past 1000-line hard limit. Separate files with _ = @import wiring adds only 2-3 lines to c_adapter.zig while keeping exports in the library.
alternatives: Add directly to c_adapter.zig (would exceed 1000 lines)
Split c_adapter.zig into c_adapter_scan.zig and c_adapter_shared.zig first (larger refactor)
entries.impact: zig/src/exports_embed.zig — new pattern for all future C ABI exports

entries.decision: Do NOT implement arena reuse via DocumentArena::reset for re-parse — benchmark shows negligible benefit
entries.rationale: Benchmark data: small doc arena lifecycle = 662ns vs 64µs full reparse (0.07% savings). Large doc: 22.5µs vs 3.36ms (0.02%). Tree-sitter parsing dominates by 100-150x. Implementation would require API changes across 4 crates (parser, core, index, lsp) for sub-0.1% improvement.
alternatives: Implement full arena reuse pipeline (not justified by data)
Pre-size arenas with Bump::with_capacity based on document size (marginal, separate concern)
entries.impact: Added DocumentArena::reset() method and investigation benchmark to memory.rs. No reindex API warranted.

entries.decision: Option A: Store MarkdownTree in separate HashMap in ServerState, extract from Ast via take_md_tree()
entries.rationale: Cleanest separation — MarkdownTree is only needed by the parser layer for incremental reuse. Storing in ServerState HashMap keeps it independent of DocumentIndex's arena ownership transfer. The Ast wraps md_tree in Option to allow taking it out before from_ast() consumes the Ast.
alternatives: Option B: Ast::into_parts() -> (DocumentArena, MarkdownTree) — requires changing from_ast signature
Option C: Store MarkdownTree inside DocumentIndex — couples tree-sitter concerns into index layer

entries.decision: Re-export MarkdownTree from markymark-parser instead of adding tree-sitter-md dependency to markymark-lsp
entries.rationale: LSP crate doesn't need direct knowledge of tree-sitter-md internals. Re-exporting from the parser crate keeps the dependency graph clean — only parser needs to know about tree-sitter-md.
alternatives: Add tree-sitter-md as direct dependency of markymark-lsp

entries.decision: DocumentChange enum in state.rs with LSP line/character fields, conversion in convert.rs
entries.rationale: Sequential change application requires interleaved UTF-16→byte conversion (each edit shifts offsets for the next). Keeping conversion interleaved with text mutation means state.rs calls convert.rs per edit. DocumentChange carries raw LSP positions to avoid leaking ls_types into state module.
alternatives: Pre-compute all byte offsets in server.rs (wrong — offsets shift after each edit)
Pass byte ranges from server.rs (requires server.rs to track evolving text)
Put conversion in state.rs directly (violates separation — convert.rs owns all LSP conversions)

entries.decision: Bounds clamping on byte offsets instead of panicking on invalid ranges
entries.rationale: String::replace_range panics on out-of-bounds indices. Editors should send valid ranges, but defensive clamping (.min(text.len()).max(start)) prevents crashes from edge cases or buggy clients without silently corrupting data.
alternatives: Trust editor sends valid ranges (panics on bad input)
Return Result and propagate error to LSP response (overengineering for a notification handler)

entries.decision: tree-sitter-md incremental parse yields ~1.3x speedup, not 10x, due to dual block+inline grammar
entries.rationale: MarkdownParser internally runs two parsers: block grammar (incremental) + inline grammar (needs reparse for affected blocks). A single-char edit in 50KB doc: full=13ms, incremental=9.5ms. The 10x acceptance criterion requires Phase 3 incremental indexing to skip AST/DocumentIndex rebuild for unchanged sections.
alternatives: Investigate inline grammar caching in tree-sitter-md fork
entries.impact: Acceptance criterion marky-zan bullet 6 (10x speedup) deferred to Phase 3 epic

entries.decision: MarkdownTree::edit() takes &InputEdit (single ref), not &[InputEdit] (slice)
entries.rationale: tree-sitter.md docs incorrectly showed md_tree.edit(&[InputEdit{...}]) with array syntax. Actual API takes &InputEdit. For sequential edits, call edit() once per change with the tree accumulating state between calls.
entries.impact: All call sites in state.rs and tests use &InputEdit{} not &[InputEdit{}]

entries.decision: Full replacement (DocumentChange::Full) invalidates old tree; only incremental edits preserve tree for reuse
entries.rationale: When editor sends full text replacement, the old tree byte ranges are meaningless. Setting old_tree=None falls back to full reparse. Incremental edits maintain tree validity through sequential edit()+parse() calls.
alternatives: Diff old/new text to construct InputEdits from Full changes (complex, fragile)
entries.impact: apply_document_changes sets old_tree=None on Full variant

entries.decision: Reuse KernelError from scan.rs instead of defining new error type in lib.rs
entries.rationale: The design doc suggested defining KernelError in lib.rs, but scan.rs already has it with the exact same variants. Moving it would require changing scan.rs imports. Using crate::scan::KernelError from the new modules avoids touching working code.
alternatives: Move KernelError to lib.rs and re-export (cleaner but changes existing code)
Define separate error types per module (more isolation but code duplication)
entries.impact: similarity.rs, hash.rs, embed.rs all import from crate::scan::KernelError

entries.decision: Use PhantomData<*mut ()> for !Send/!Sync on EmbeddingIndex instead of negative trait impls
entries.rationale: impl !Send and impl !Sync require nightly Rust (feature gate negative_impls). This project uses stable Rust. PhantomData<*mut ()> achieves the same effect since raw pointers are !Send + !Sync.
alternatives: Just document that it's not thread-safe without enforcing (unsafe)

entries.decision: Fix exports_embed.zig with comptime { _ = @import } at module level in c_adapter.zig
entries.rationale: The previous session wired exports_embed.zig via _ = @import inside a test block. This makes export fn declarations visible during zig build test but NOT in the library build (zig build lib). Symbols were missing at link time. Moving to comptime at module level ensures exports are always included.
alternatives: Move export fn declarations directly into c_adapter.zig (violates 1000-line limit)
Add exports_embed.zig to build.zig as separate compilation unit (more complex build)
entries.impact: zig/src/c_adapter.zig — critical fix for all future exports_*.zig files
